def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    open_prices = [150, 152, 153, 151, 152, 150, 149, 151, 150, 148, 147, 146, 148, 149, 147]
    close_prices = [152, 150, 152, 153, 151, 152, 150, 149, 151, 150, 149, 148, 146, 147, 148]
    period = 14

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    gains = [max(close_prices[i] - open_prices[i], 0) for i in range(1, len(open_prices))]
    losses = [max(open_prices[i] - close_prices[i], 0) for i in range(1, len(open_prices))]
    total_gains = sum(gains[-period:])
    total_losses = sum(losses[-period:])
    answer = round(total_gains / (total_gains + total_losses) * 100, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
